images.caption: ST MARTHA’S — SUNDRIES. The date has gone brown along with the rest of the paper. The biro underneath has not: “Do not order the cheap ones again.”

images.caption: FIRST CATCH. “Not the same thing. Watch the units.”

images.printed: HOPPER. · Cross-section · {{bnd.X}} square centimetres, · exactly. · Depth · {{bnd.D}} centimetres.
images.caption: “Cut it myself, it is exact.” The depth was measured to the nearest centimetre.

images.printed: The smallest volume it could possibly be holding.
images.caption: “The hopper drops its catch when it is told this. Not what is in it. The least it could be.”

images.printed: Set the lamp to the warming rate it should expect, in degrees every ten minutes.
images.caption: “The lamp holds the last catch until it is set right. Get it wrong and it simply goes on holding.”

images.text: You are not going to be the one who moves it.
